commit.message:
8389666: C2: assert(false) failed: unexpected scalar opcode for integer DivV*

JDK-8387594 added AArch64 SVE support for vector integer division
(`DivVB/DivVS/DivVI/DivVL`), `VectorNode::scalar_opcode()` maps these
nodes to `Op_DivI / Op_DivL`. That makes them eligible for
`VectorNode::push_through_replicate()`, but `VectorNode::make_scalar()`
was not updated to construct `DivINode / DivLNode`.

As a result, Idealizing a vector integer division whose inputs are both
Replicate hits:
```
  assert(false) failed: unexpected scalar opcode
  at VectorNode::make_scalar
  at VectorNode::push_through_replicate
```

This was observed with VectorExpressionFuzzer, e.g.:
```
  IntVector.broadcast(SPECIES_128, -4096)
           .div(IntVector.broadcast(SPECIES_128, 1));
```

Reproduction:
```
make test TEST="test/hotspot/jtreg/compiler/vectorapi/VectorExpressionFuzzer.java" \
  TEST_VM_OPTS="-Djdk.test.lib.random.seed=-7741787539408201128"
```

This PR updates `Op_DivI / Op_DivL` in `VectorNode::make_scalar()` to
fix this issue.

This PR also added some test cases for division in
`test/hotspot/jtreg/compiler/vectorapi/TestVectorBroadcastTransforms.java`.
